checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the heavy depth-of-field blur renders lower-body anatomical checkpoints (legs, tail, chest proportions) untestable. This is a rigorous and accurate application of the 'is_testable' rule. The visible facial features (otter head, V-ears, mask) were correctly marked as present and matching the Border Terrier standard. I agree with all verdicts.
artifact_review: The Router noted 'blur' (severity 2) and minor 'texture anomaly' (severity 1). The Perceptual Quality Auditor confirmed 'slight blur' (0.2 severity), suggesting the blur is likely optical rather than AI smearing. However, the Animal Pose Auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk (53% low-confidence keypoints), particularly in the hind limbs and hips. While the Reflector instructions advise caution with low-confidence keypoints due to domain shift, the combination of extreme blur and high pose uncertainty suggests the lower body structure is ambiguous. I will maintain the Router's severity assessment but note that the structural integrity of the blurred regions is unverifiable, which impacts the alignment score more than the artifact score.
alignment_reasoning: The fine-grained classifier strongly confirms the 'Border terrier' class (logit 7.58 vs 2.51 for next best). Visible facial checkpoints (head shape, ears, mask) are perfectly aligned with taxonomy. However, ~50% of checkpoints are untestable due to blur, preventing full anatomical verification. The high pose uncertainty in the blurred regions prevents a perfect alignment score, as we cannot confirm the 'narrow chest' or 'straight legs' distinctives.
artifact_reasoning: No catastrophic structural failures (melting/fusion) are visible in the sharp regions. The primary artifact is significant depth-of-field blur, which the perceptual auditor rates as slight/optical. The high pose error rate is likely due to the blur obscuring limb joints rather than genuine anatomical hallucination, but it introduces uncertainty. The image is clean of noise/compression artifacts.
key_defects: Untestable lower body anatomy due to extreme blur
